subject: Final MAP & signature sprint — go/no-go checkpoint and start date
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 10 Apr 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft MAP + proposed sprint for signature and start date

Hi Alyssa —

Thanks again for the time on the call today. Per our discussion I attached a cleaned-up MAP (RDW-Atlas-MAP-v3.pdf) that lays out the evaluation checkpoints, legal review windows, and the final go/no-go on the week of 4/25. Key dates I want to call out: 

- 4/12: Atlas completes tech eval (we provide runbook + sample prompts)
- 4/15–4/18: Procurement + legal to review SOW and pricing redlines
- 4/20: Internal executive approval window (Redwood) — we need commitment on discount override if required
- 4/22: Target DocuSign routing (signature sprint)
- 5/3: Target production start date (first reserved capacity run)

Action items for Atlas: please confirm procurement reviewer and whether you need a separate NDA addendum for the VPC deployment. I copied Marissa and Ben to keep us in lockstep on pricing and any escalation if legal requests changes.

Attachments: [RDW-Atlas-MAP-v3.pdf (PDF, 158 KB)]

Thanks,
Karthik
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123
From: Alyssa Park <alyssa@atlasretail.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Bennett <tbennett@atlasretail.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft MAP + proposed sprint for signature and start date

Karthik —

Thanks for the MAP. High-level: procurement will review the SOW but legal wants an extra clause around data residency and audit access (SOC2 evidence). Tom (copied) is procurement — he and legal will coordinate. Two asks from our side: 1) can the signature sprint be moved up one business day to 4/21? procurement has a window that week and 2) we need a clear playbook for a temporary rollback if the first week in prod shows latency regressions.

Can you confirm whether the rollback and residency language are things Redwood can accept as standard (we prefer not to add bespoke language)?

—Alyssa
Alyssa Park
Director, AI Platform — Atlas Retail
alyssa@atlasretail.com | +1 (212) 555-0845
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2027 08:29:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Draft MAP + proposed sprint for signature and start date

Folks — forwarding Alyssa's procurement asks. Two items I need input on quickly: 

1) Residency / SOC2 evidence — can we provide the standard SOC2 packet and confirm retention windows (Atlas asked for 12 months)?
2) Rollback/playbook — they want a rollback plan documented that we can execute within the first 48 hours if latency regressions occur. Will this require an SLA exception or added runbook work?

We're potentially moving signature sprint to 4/21 — if legal requests redlines that impacts our internal approval on 4/20. Please reply with yes/no and any blocker.

Thanks — K

> Attachment: SOW-Atlas-Standard-draft.docx (DOCX, 84 KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2027 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft MAP + proposed sprint for signature and start date

Karthik / Ben —

SOC2 packet: yes, we can deliver the standard SOC2 zips and a KMS/HSM summary. Retention windows: default is 12 months; we'll confirm in writing in the SOW.

Rollback playbook: engineering (Ben) says this is operationally straightforward — we will prep a one-page rollback checklist (failover to cached model variant, pin previous model version, and route traffic to dedicated pool) and include it as an appendix to the MAP. No SLA exception required for the rollback itself; if Atlas wants an automated RTO guarantee we need to scope additional monitoring (could be an add-on).

Pricing/approvals: if procurement insists on moving signature to 4/21 we can accelerate approval prep, but I need Ben to ok the rollback appendix and I need Monica to confirm the discount floor.

Marissa
VP, Sales — Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2027 10:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Draft MAP + proposed sprint for signature and start date

Confirming: we can produce the rollback checklist and a short runbook by EOD 4/19. It will include exact commands, KV-cache purge steps, and who to call (SRE pager + on-call engineering). No runtime changes required to support the rollback. If Atlas wants an automated fallback with traffic mirroring, that's additional work and budget.

Ben
Senior SRE — Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alyssa Park <alyssa@atlasretail.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Tom Bennett <tbennett@atlasretail.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Final MAP & signature sprint — confirmed 4/21 routing, DocuSign link, and 5/3 start

Alyssa / Tom —

Thanks for the quick coordination. Per internal review we're aligned on the following final commitments and cadence: 

- SOC2 evidence & retention confirmation: standard packet delivered; 12 month retention confirmed (attached in final SOW).
- Rollback appendix: one-page checklist + on-call contacts to be attached to the MAP (we will deliver file by 4/19 EOD).
- Pricing & discount: Marissa confirmed discount floor; final pricing is in the attached Pricing-Worksheet.xlsx.
- Signature routing: DocuSign envelope prepared — requested routing for Tom -> Alyssa -> RDW legal -> RDW sales exec. We can move to sign on 4/21 per your procurement window.
- Target prod start date: 2027-05-03 (post-signature validation + onboarding hold).

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/embedded-signing/rdw-atlas-2027
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/67890

If this matches Atlas' understanding please reply with a one-line go/no-go and we will route the envelope.

Thanks,
Karthik
